document.title: Mobile phone owners and their use
document.question:
The graph below shows the percentage of adults who owned a mobile phone between 2005 and 2025. The pie chart shows what they used their phones for most in 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
